purpose: Mandatory pre-GPU positive control: verify StrongResidualPairScorer CAN fit a known utility landscape via the real pairwise_step_loss, before trusting a negative result on the real ETTh1 task.

setup.landscape: synthetic, known closed-form utility function of (h_t, e_i)
setup.loss: pairwise_step_loss (same function used in R1/R2/C2 training)

metric: mean oracle-best predicted rank across queries
observed: < 20 / 256 (assertion satisfied; see test file for exact value at last run)
interpretation: StrongResidualPairScorer + pairwise_step_loss has enough capacity and the training loop is wired correctly to fit a top-tail ranking signal when one exists in the input features. A negative/mixed result on the real ETTh1 C2 run is therefore not attributable to a broken scorer or broken training loop.
